_readme: WORLD [the valley has no inside] 10/10: the valley's insides as one table. Written by tools/bohemia_the_insides_cook_10_10_26.js from engine/bohemia_insides.js -- do not hand edit. THE ROW WAS WRONG AND THIS LANE WROTE IT: the valley has had an inside since 7/26 (engine/bohemia_floorplan.js, the INTERIOR-MATCHES-EXTERIOR LAW, a 62-district room-grammar table). What is wrong is that THE TABLE EXISTS TWICE -- DISTGEN in the engine and IN_ZONE in the CITY app -- and the copies disagree on six districts, every disagreement collapsing a specific grammar into the generic `institutional`, so a POLICE STATION IS GENERATED WITH TWO HOSPITAL WARDS IN IT. No second copy of the table is made here: the rows below are read from the live DISTGEN by the gate.

theTableExistsTwice.allOneWay: every disagreement collapses a specific grammar into the generic `institutional`, so the app is holding the OLD table
theTableExistsTwice.costsOnTheGlass: a police station, a fire station, a school and a bus terminal are each generated with two hospital wards in them, and the firehouse (a garage and an office) and transit (a concourse and a counter) grammars exist and are never used
theTableExistsTwice.ruling: DISTGEN in engine/bohemia_world.js, the one district -> room-grammar table this lane owns. Read live by the gate, never copied here.

correctlyNone.why: not a building. A road, a wash, a mountain and a spring have no inside to generate, and a grammar for one would be a room nobody built.

owesOne.why: every one of these is a building people went inside. FOUR OF THEM ARE THE STRIP'S OWN CASINOS -- the Luxor, the Sphere, the Stratosphere, the High Roller -- in a game whose one hand-made interior board is a casino floor.
owesOne.blockedBecause: a DISTGEN row needs a kit module and a footprint function, and these seven have no kit module at all. That is the open row [the cells with no board]'s own list, so it is one job and not two.
